description: Description Amazon is looking for a Business Analyst in the Fresh team. This opportunity is ideal for candidates looking to have a steep learning curve, expand their knowledge of retail, e-commerce & customer behavior, and derive insights from data to influence key business decisions for Amazon customers and derive continuous improvement using data analysis. Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused and passionate about e-commerce, then come join us in our mission “to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices”. Key job responsibilities A Business Analyst role in the Fresh team is a high visibility role who works with multiple stakeholders and teams across the org to derive insights from data and support day to day business decisions. Some of the key result areas include, but not limited to: Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions Ensure data accuracy by validating data for new and existing tools. Learn and understand a broad range of Amazon’s data resources and know how, when, and which to use and which not to use. Work closely with marketing, product, category, customer service, tech and finance stakeholders to understand the business requirements and provide analyses. Understand trends related to Amazon business and recommend strategies to stakeholders to help drive business growth. Identify, develop, manage, and execute analyses to uncover areas of opportunity and present written business recommendations that will help shape the direction of the business. The ideal candidate actively seeks to understand Amazon’s core business values and initiatives, and translates those into everyday practices. A day in the life This role provides opportunities to influence high impact / high visibility projects within the organization. To perform your daily tasks, one requires high attention to details, proven ability to manage multiple and competing priorities simultaneously. This is a fast-paced environment where continuous innovation is expected, a superior and crisp verbal/written communication is primary skill and ambiguity is a norm. Bias for action, customer obsession and ownership are some of key leadership principles this role should strive for. This role requires superior analytical skill set, able to quickly address problems and apply analytical expertise to rapidly solution and deliver. The whole cycle would involve interaction with many teams. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving, be able to measure and estimate risks, constructively critique peer research, extract and manipulate data across various data marts. About The Team The Fresh Growth-CX Analytics team is responsible for providing analytics, insights and support to Amazon India Fresh Marketing and Product teams. The scope of this team includes managing weekly/monthly review decks, formulating new metrics, provide visibility to daily performance through automated reports and dashboards, building optimization tools. This is done by liaising with local and global technology teams to get things done through influence and/or with their support. Our roadmap includes long term projects that have quarterly deadlines and sprint projects that are executed in weekly sprints. Basic Qualifications 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience Bachelor's degree Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. Company - ASSPL - Karnataka - B56 Job ID: A10483113
title: Business Analyst, Amazon Fresh

description: Join the Future of EdTech with Learnosity Power the future of learning worldwide with Learnosity Learnosity is looking for bright minds to help bring AI magic to real-world learning. We're looking for exceptional engineers, product thinkers, designers, data scientists, researchers, and AI specialists who want to do career-defining work with global impact. Who we are Learnosity is the global leader in assessment solutions. We provide experiences that are digital, dynamic, and designed to meet the needs of modern learners to test and prove knowledge. Our technology powers assessment for hundreds of organizations of all sizes and reaches over 40 million learners every year. And we want you to help drive our next wave of AI-led innovations. Why Join Us? Visibility & Influence : Operate in an environment where there's minimal distance between ideas and decision-making, with direct access to senior leadership and the ability to shape meaningful outcomes. Pragmatic Innovation : Help shape how AI and other new technologies are applied where they deliver genuine value. Build & Scale : Help shape new products while leveraging the platform, customers, and reach of an established global business. Real Impact : Build systems and products that directly influence how millions of learners are assessed and supported worldwide. Ownership & Collaboration : Take responsibility for your work while collaborating with experienced, thoughtful teammates across engineering, product, and design. Growth & Development : Develop your career in an environment that values continuous learning, leadership and long-term growth. If you're motivated by building meaningful products at scale, and want to improve how people learn worldwide, we'd love to hear from you. Help Shape How the World Creates Learning Behind every great assessment is a great authoring experience. As a Product Manager in Learnosity's Authoring domain, you'll help build the tools, APIs, and workflows that educators, assessment creators, content teams, and developers use to create learning experiences for millions of learners worldwide. You'll work at the intersection of product innovation, developer platforms, AI-powered workflows, and large-scale assessment technology, helping customers create better content faster while shaping the future of assessment authoring. If you're excited by platform products, creator experiences, and solving complex problems that impact learning at global scale, we'd love to hear from you. Why This Role Matters Authoring sits at the foundation of everything Learnosity delivers. Before a learner takes an assessment, before results are analysed, before learning outcomes are measured, someone has to create the content. The products you'll help shape make that possible. This role combines the challenge of maintaining and evolving mature platform capabilities with the opportunity to rethink how content creation works in an AI-enabled world. You'll help educators, publishers, assessment organisations, and developers create richer learning experiences while influencing the future direction of one of the most widely used assessment authoring platforms in education technology. Quick Facts Location: Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid - minimum 1 day per week in office) Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Team: Build - Authoring Reports to: VP Product, Australia Working Pattern: Regular collaboration across Europe, Australia, and North America, including recurring out-of-hours meetings. What You'll Achieve in Your First 12 Months Take ownership of key areas within Learnosity's Authoring product portfolio and develop a deep understanding of how customers create and manage assessment content. Deliver valuable new capabilities that improve authoring workflows for educators, content creators, and developers. Successfully balance customer requests, strategic initiatives, platform improvements, technical debt, and maintenance activities. Partner closely with Engineering and Design teams to take features from discovery through delivery and release. Build strong customer feedback loops and use customer insights and product data to influence roadmap priorities. Support the successful rollout and adoption of new authoring capabilities across the platform. Contribute to the adoption of AI-enabled product development practices and help identify opportunities for AI-powered authoring experiences. Build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Support, and Sales teams. A Typical Week Might Include Running discovery sessions with customers to understand content creation challenges and workflow bottlenecks. Collaborating with Engineers and Designers to refine upcoming features and platform improvements. Reviewing customer feedback, product analytics, and adoption metrics. Prioritising roadmap initiatives, platform enhancements, technical debt, and maintenance work. Demonstrating new capabilities to customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders. Working with Customer Success and Support teams to understand customer needs and emerging opportunities. Exploring how AI can improve content creation, workflow efficiency, and product development processes. You'll Work With Public APIs and developer-facing products. Content authoring and workflow management platforms. Product discovery and customer research methodologies. Agile software development teams. AI-assisted product development workflows. Product analytics and customer feedback platforms. Cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Support, and Sales. Requirements What We're Looking For Essential 3+ years' experience in Product Management or a similar product-focused role. Experience working with API products or developer-focused products. Experience working with mature software products operating at scale. Strong technical literacy and understanding of modern web applications. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Strong product judgement and ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities. AI literacy and enthusiasm for using AI to improve product development and decision-making. Nice to Have Experience in EdTech or educational environments. Experience as an educator, content creator, instructional designer, or working closely with learning products. Passion for accessibility and inclusive product design. Experience working within SaaS, platform-based, or developer-focused software environments. Benefits Paid sick leave Generous annual and parental leave Health & dental insurance Pension contributions Learning & development support Employee Assistance Program Flexible work practices Commuter benefits Modern city-centre office Our Values We are a values-driven company, and how we work matters as much as what we build: We live to learn We aim higher We do the right thing Our success is better shared Ready to Apply? Apply with your CV. We aim to keep our hiring process straightforward, transparent, and respectful of your time. Find out more about your career at Learnosity at learnosity.com/careers/ Please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy Salary & package dependent on experience. Please only contact us if you are a candidate interested in applying for this role. You must have the right to live and work in Ireland to apply.
title: Product Manager Authoring
